_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

voltage.why: the force downhill returning — the forces chapter under a new name; learning IS a body sliding steepest-descent on a landscape, gravity re-cast as optimization
the loss is the trained-in value — three losses on one dataset means three different 'wrongs'; who chose the objective? the bias is authored before a single step is taken
learning as compression — the thesis: inference = compression = entropy; attention squeezes the world into a shorter code, the network is a seed that costs to run
learning with NO fitness function — the QFEP turn on 'training toward a goal'; bodies that reproduce without an objective, the queer refusal of the optimized scoreboard
overfitting as memorization-vs-understanding made visible — SHAP/LIME open the black box to ask whether it learned the world or memorized the test; the dark spot inside the trained model
